about: The labelled set VCST-6122 is measured against (built in stage M0): ~120 rows, split BY ENTRY so every row about one entry (or one group of entries that share a row) sits in one split, and a question written for an entry never reaches that entry's held-out test. A TARGET names every entry that answers it (`expect`); it passes when one of them is picked/ranked. A CONTROL is a question the base holds nothing on -- verified by reading the bodies of the candidate entries, never by a ranker verdict -- and `near` names the entries it is a near neighbour of. `partial: true` marks a target whose entry holds the fact only in part. `source`: existing (the VCST-6087 set, unchanged), wave1 (the 40 asks of VCST-6087-wave1, labelled by the operator; `cite` gives the log line and the agent's verdict), paraphrase (written by a different model from the entry's claim alone, never its subject or question; `support` is the sentence that answers it), control (new near-neighbour controls). `split`: dev | calibration | test. The groups of the five wave-1 misses (P1, P3, P6, L1, L6) are forced into dev, because the vocabulary is seeded from them; the "five misses answered" criterion is reported separately. Controls are split by a seeded hash. `contested` rows are excluded from every metric until the contradiction they depend on is settled live.

baseline.recorded: REFERENCE, not the production bar. Measured 2026-09-30 on vc-knowledge@8c8f844 with the benches of PR #337 (commit eff4c333, not merged into main; the --set/--split reader was added locally for this run): two-stage-1 = `bench-two-stage.mjs --view hybrid --k 10 --runs 3` (judge claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, majority of 3), floor-1b = `bench-rank.mjs` top 3. Re-scored the same day after relabelling 6 rows (see `relabelled` on each): the judge verdicts are the saved runs, unchanged -- the judge never sees a label -- and Stage 1 recall is recomputed on the same snapshot. main ranks with floor-1, which this block does not measure.
baseline.note: The one remaining wrong pick is W-L5 -> KB-C1024558: that entry says how to tell a coupon discount from an automatic one, not whether the summary shows them on separate lines. Controls picked: C-smoke-path (KB-50EBEEE9, 2 of 3 runs) and W-L8 (KB-25388E6C / KB-409CE7C7, the borderline control).

baselineFloor1.recorded: THE PRODUCTION BAR M4 replaces: floor-1, what main runs (rank.mjs scoreRows + admissible, top 3 bodies). Measured 2026-09-30 on vc-knowledge branch vcst-6122-schema2 @ f188eb8 (334 retrievable rows) with scripts/kb/bench/verdict-bench.mjs --decider floor-1. The answer is the FIRST hit; top3 counts a right entry anywhere in the returned list and is not an answer. floor-1 reads subject + question only, never the card. Tokens = chars/4 of the rendered ask text. Test split not opened: it is measured once, at the gate.
baselineFloor1.causes: dev + calibration, 88 rows. Targets: 18 with the right entry ranked FIRST and refused by the coverage floor; 16 at rank 2-10; 8 below 10; 4 sharing no word; 7 answered right (3 by anchor, 4 by words); 6 answered wrong (5 by anchor, 1 by words). Controls: 17 none; 12 answered (7 by anchor, 5 by words). 15 active entries carry /cart (14 on 8c8f844), and an anchor passes unconditionally, so a question naming /cart is answered by whichever of them shares the most common words.
baselineFloor1.agreesWithReference: admission is floor-1b's, so controls answered is directly comparable: dev 7/19 here vs 8/19 on 8c8f844, calibration 5/10 vs 5/10; top3 7/37 and 2/22, same as floor1bTop3.
